_note: Pichhle saal ke GDS->MTS/Postman paper ke sawal. Jawab = paper ki answer key + PO Guide se milaan (dono sahi hon tabhi). 'exams' = jin parikshaon me ye sawal aaya (ek pariksha ki do PDF ek hi ginti). 'MTS + Postman 2022' wale 25-key PDF bahar rakhe (key sawalon se mel nahi khaati). Naye sawal jodne ho to isi dhaanche me.
